description: This file defines internal structures and function pointers related to transport mechanisms in a version control system, such as setting options, fetching refs, pushing refs, and managing connection lifecycle.

methods.name: set_option
methods.description: Sets a specific option for a transport connection.

methods.name: get_refs_list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of references from the remote transport.

methods.name: get_bundle_uri
methods.description: Obtains the bundle URI for protocol v2, if advertised.

methods.name: fetch_refs
methods.description: Fetches objects for specified refs from the remote.

methods.name: push_refs
methods.description: Pushes objects and refs to the remote.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the remote transport.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the transport connection.

ctags.name: connect
ctags.typeref: typename:int (*)(struct transport * connection,const char * name,const char * executable,int fd[2])

ctags.name: fetch_refs
ctags.pattern: /^	int (*fetch_refs)(struct transport *transport, int refs_nr, struct ref **refs);$/
ctags.typeref: typename:int (*)(struct transport * transport,int refs_nr,struct ref ** refs)

ctags.name: get_refs_list
ctags.typeref: struct:ref * (*)(struct transport * transport,int for_push,struct transport_ls_refs_options * transport_options)

ctags.name: push_refs
ctags.pattern: /^	int (*push_refs)(struct transport *transport, struct ref *refs, int flags);$/
ctags.typeref: typename:int (*)(struct transport * transport,struct ref * refs,int flags)

ctags.name: set_option
ctags.typeref: typename:int (*)(struct transport * connection,const char * name,const char * value)
